title: Diagnosing and Mitigating Domain Shift in Permission-Based Android Malware Detection
abstract: arXiv:2605.09028v5 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Machine learning-based Android malware detectors often fail in real-world deployment due to domain shift, where models trained on one data source perform poorly on applications from another. This paper presents a comprehensive study on the generalizability and interpretability of permission-based detectors under cross-domain conditions. Using two complementary datasets (PerMalDroid and NATICUSdroid) and five ensemble classifiers, we first establish an intra-domain baseline, where models achieve over 92% accuracy, and then quantify a severe asymmetric performance drop. While models trained on PerMalDroid generalize well to NATICUSdroid (86% accuracy), the reverse direction sees a drastic drop to 73% accuracy. Explainable AI analysis reveals bimodal feature distributions and shows that feature importance is highly unstable, with key permissions losing or gaining influence across domains. translated_title: 基于权限的Android恶意软件检测中的领域偏移诊断与缓解
translated_abstract: 基于机器学习的Android恶意软件检测器在现实世界部署中常常失效，原因在于领域偏移，即在某一数据源上训练的模型在来自另一数据源的应用上表现不佳。本文对基于权限的检测器在跨域条件下的泛化能力和可解释性进行了全面研究。使用两个互补的数据集（PerMalDroid和NATICUSdroid）以及五个集成分类器，我们首先建立了域内基线，模型准确率超过92%，随后量化了严重的不对称性能下降。虽然在PerMalDroid上训练的模型能够较好地泛化到NATICUSdroid（准确率86%），但反方向训练的模型准确率则急剧下降至73%。可解释AI分析揭示了特征分布的双峰特性，并表明特征重要性高度不稳定，关键权限在不同领域间会失去或获得影响力。不同领域的预测特征集……
tldr: 本文系统诊断了基于权限的Android恶意软件检测器在跨域场景下的领域偏移问题，揭示了严重的非对称性能下降与特征重要性的跨域不稳定性，并提出了相应的缓解方法。
en_tdlr: This paper comprehensively diagnoses domain shift in permission-based Android malware detection, revealing a severe asymmetric performance drop across domains and highly unstable feature importance, and provides mitigation strategies.
